deadline.value: Apply by Tuesday, December 1, 2026, 8:59 pm Pacific, for Fall 2027 (fall intake only).
deadline.quote: The deadline to apply is Tuesday, December 1st, 2026 at 8:59pm Pacific Time.

gre_general.value: Only the Mathematics Subject GRE is required; you may also submit the General GRE.
gre_general.quote: You may still submit other GRE results, such as the General exam; however, only the subject test in Mathematics is required.

gre_subject.value: The Mathematics Subject GRE is required for Fall 2027; a low score makes admission very unlikely.
gre_subject.quote: For the Fall 2027 Admissions Cycle, the Mathematics Subject GRE will be required.

also.quote: it is very unlikely that an applicant with a low GRE score will be admitted.

supervisor.value: Admission is decided by the department's Graduate Admissions Committee; no supervisor agreement is needed.
supervisor.quote: Applicants for admission are considered by the department's Graduate Admissions Committee.

funding.value: The department pledges at least 5 years of funding to incoming PhD students, subject to good progress and satisfactory teaching.
funding.quote: The Department pledges incoming PhD students sufficient financial support so that they have funding for at least 5 years of graduate study at Berkeley, subject to the student making good progress toward the degree and satisfactory performance of all teaching duties.

entry_route.value: Applicants are expected to have preparation comparable to a Berkeley undergraduate major in mathematics or applied mathematics.
entry_route.quote: Applicants for admission to either Ph.D. program are expected to have preparation comparable to the undergraduate major at Berkeley in Mathematics or in Applied Mathematics.

notes: One admissions process covers the PhD in Mathematics and the PhD in Applied Mathematics.
